item.title: Inside the Wang Contemporary, Alexander Wang’s New Cross-Disciplinary Arts Platform
item.description: "What really excites me is the opportunity to collaborate with artists outside of fashion and to continue learning from creatives working in entirely different forms—it feels like the beginning of a new dialogue," he told Observer.

item.title: Sam Altman and Dario Amodei Make India Their Next A.I. Battleground
item.description: In New Delhi, Altman and Amodei signal that India is central to their battle for global A.I. dominance.

item.title: Nunu Hung’s Year of Ambition, Intellectual Depth and Unapologetic Openness
item.description: "The program is more than simply a series of individual exhibitions that end once they are deinstalled; when audiences look back on the full arc of the year, I hope they see a space deeply committed to intergenerational, intersectional and global narratives," she tells Observer.

item.title: The 10 Gourmet Grocers Fueling Miami’s Wellness Moment
item.description: Erewhon, who? These markets turn grocery shopping into an epicurean adventure.

item.title: One Fine Show: Art from the Dean Collection of Swizz Beatz and Alicia Keys at the VMFA
item.description: Exhibitions of art collections are not meant to be cohesive; this one is a mixtape where each track is strong even if it doesn't flow naturally into the next.

item.title: Pier Paolo Calzolari On the Quiet Alchemy of Time
item.description: "For me, Arte Povera was about understanding everything as part of a broader whole, trying to merge with it, to understand it, to follow it in some way. There is a kind of familiarity with things," the artist told Observer.

item.title: An Oregon Sommelier Maps the Best Tasting Rooms in Willamette Valley
item.description: A local expert reveals where pinot noir, chardonnay and sparkling truly shine in Oregon's premier wine region.

item.title: Sam Altman’s Acqui-Hire of OpenClaw’s Peter Steinberger May Define ChatGPT’s Future
item.description: OpenAI hires OpenClaw founder Peter Steinberger to advance personal A.I. agents, even as experts warn of privacy and security concerns.

item.title: Warren Buffett’s Final Berkshire Bet Brings Him Back to Newspapers
item.description: Warren Buffett’s final Berkshire Hathaway investment reflects a full-circle return to the newspaper business that launched his career.

item.title: Dean Majd’s “Hard Feelings” Expands the Emotional Register of Masculinity
item.description: In his debut solo exhibition at BAXTER ST, the photographer depicts intimacy, grief, fraternity and joy among men with rare candor.
